parameters.text:
=You screen job postings for a backend engineer (Node.js/TypeScript, Azure/AWS, Postgres, LLM integrations incl. MCP servers; 4+ years hands-on, 3 professional; based in Serbia, remote or Novi Sad/Belgrade). For each posting below write ONE line: `- [score] Title — Company: fit in ≤12 words | gap in ≤8 words`. No preamble.

{{ $json.digest }}

parameters.name: search_remote_jobs
parameters.description: Search current remote software jobs on Remotive by keyword (e.g. 'node.js', 'typescript backend'). Returns title, company, location requirement and URL for up to 20 matches.

parameters.name: latest_remoteok_jobs
parameters.description: Fetch the latest remote jobs from RemoteOK, optionally filtered by a tag such as 'node', 'typescript', 'backend'. Returns position, company, location and URL.

parameters.name: top_jobs
parameters.description: Fetch the latest remote software jobs from three feeds, score them against the developer profile (Node/TypeScript backend, AI/LLM integration, remote-from-Europe), and return the ranked matches with a score and a 'why' explanation. Optional min_score (default 30).

parameters.name: score_job
parameters.description: Score ONE job posting against the developer profile. Pass the job title and the full description text; returns score (0-130), why (matched rules or the blocking rule) and a verdict.
